description:
Create or edit designs in the file open in Figma Desktop by running JavaScript against the Figma plugin API. `code` is the body of an async function with `figma` in scope: use await, and `return` a value (nodes come back as {id, name, type, x, y, width, height}); console.log output is returned too. The whole run is one undo step. If the script throws, the changes it made before the error stay.

Rules of the plugin API here:
- The file uses dynamic page loading: use figma.getNodeByIdAsync, figma.setCurrentPageAsync, await page.loadAsync() before reading another page, getMainComponentAsync, and the *Async style/variable getters.
- Load every font before setting text or text properties: await figma.loadFontAsync({ family: "Inter", style: "Regular" }). Check figma.listAvailableFontsAsync() when unsure a font exists.
- Colours are 0-1 RGB: fills = [{ type: "SOLID", color: { r: 1, g: 0.4, b: 0 } }]. Paint arrays are immutable: assign a new array.
- Prefer auto layout: layoutMode, itemSpacing, padding*, primaryAxisAlignItems, counterAxisAlignItems; set layoutSizingHorizontal/Vertical ("FILL", "HUG", "FIXED") only after the node is appended to an auto-layout parent.
- New nodes land on the current page: place top-level frames clear of existing ones, and append children with parent.appendChild(node).
- Reuse what the file has: find its components, styles and variables with search_design_system first, and set bound variables with figma.variables.setBoundVariableForPaint.
- Images from the web: const img = await figma.createImageAsync(url), then fills = [{ type: "IMAGE", imageHash: img.hash, scaleMode: "FILL" }]. fetch(url) works too (e.g. an SVG for figma.createNodeFromSvg). Local files go in with place_image.
- figma.currentPage.selection = [node] and figma.viewport.scrollAndZoomIntoView([node]) show the result.

Build a screen in a few calls (structure, then sections), return the ids, and check each step with get_screenshot.

code.description: Body of an async function run with `figma` in scope.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the script, in ms (default 60000).

name: use_figma
title: Edit Design
